findings.issue: 'Disciple' is frozen as الحواريّ, and its glossary note explicitly rules out the neighbouring cult ranks (NOT تابع = Vassal, NOT المُريد = Acolyte, NOT عابد الطائفة = Cultist). التلميذ ('pupil/student') is a fourth unapproved word, and it is a map/area name the player sees repeatedly.

'Brigand' is rendered قُطّاع طرق everywhere else in the corpus (brigand-swill, 'I think I've seen brigands drinking it', 'But these brigands…'). اللصوص ('thieves') is a different group, and the English is singular.

'Unfound' means not yet discovered, not 'unknown'. المجهول is also already doing duty for 'Nameless' in this same batch set (The Nameless Captive = الأسير المجهول), so two distinct English words collapse onto one Arabic name.
